quotes.text: If you contest a Mastercard compliance dispute, Stripe collects a 500 USD (or local equivalent) amount in addition to the applicable Stripe dispute fee or fees.
Stripe refunds the 500 USD network fee if you win the dispute.
Mastercard uses a two-stage escalation process where a pre-compliance filing can escalate to a full compliance case.
You’ve only one opportunity to submit your response. Stripe immediately forwards your response and all supporting files to the issuing bank.
